strings.(게르다 마을 한 편에 있는 벤치에 이오가 멍한 표정으로 앉아 있다.): (Io sits blankly on a bench in a quiet part of Gerda Village.)
strings.아침부터 바삐 움직였지 않니? 집안 청소도 모자라 마을 청소하고, 빨래도: You've been busy since morning. You cleaned your house and the village, did the laundry, played with the children, exercised, and had a meal.
strings.이제 세 시간 지났을 뿐인데, 할 일이 없다고? 그냥 아무 생각 없이 쉬: It's only been three hours, and you say there's nothing to do? Just rest without thinking for a while.
I suppose it's because I no longer have to do all the things I used to.
strings.아무것도 하지 않고 심심해하는 그 언니처럼은 아니지만, 네 입에서 그런: You're not like that older girl who does nothing and complains of boredom, but I'm still surprised to hear you say it.
strings.그러게. 수백 년동안 심심할 틈이 없이 일을 해서 이런 감정조차 오랜만인: I know. I've worked for centuries without a moment to be bored. Even this feeling is unfamiliar now.
A visitor arrives just in time.
We have been waiting for you, %s.
strings.이오가 심심하다고 노래를 부르니 어찌한답니까?: Io keeps singing about how bored she is. What am I to do?
I can't believe Io is bored. She's not Lady Shynic...
strings.그러게 말입니다. 흐음…. 수백년을 함께 했는데, 이오가 이리 심심해 하: Indeed. We have been together for centuries, and I have never seen her like this.
strings.용의 계곡까지 말이냐?: All the way to Dragon Valley?
strings.아니, 지금은 불타는 수레바퀴 안에 계셔. 설원과도 가까우니 나린도 갈: No. He's inside the Burning Wheel now. It's near the snowfield, so you can come too, Narin.
Very well. Let us go together.
If he's in the wheel, he must be in his true form.
strings.응, 맞아. 아드키나 님께서 에너지를 많이 쓰셨는지 배고파하시더라. 그래: Yes. Lord Atkina seems to have used a lot of energy. He's hungry, so I want to bring something to tempt his appetite.
strings.오, 좋네요. 설화로 가면 되나요?: That sounds good. To the Snowflower Inn?
No, to Icicle Prison. I made a separate freezer there.
strings.이오, 설마 '그것'인게냐?: Io, surely you do not mean 'that'?
Yes. A dish inspired by the latest trend in Freios. Galette helped me make it.
strings.(나린이 이오와 %s의 손에 있는 음식을 보더니 할 말을 잃는다.): (Narin stares speechlessly at the food Io and %s are holding.)
strings.이오, 너는 어찌 이것에 꽂힌게냐?: Io, how did you become so fond of this?
strings.정령인 나도 이게 확실히 호불호가 있을 거란 걸 안단다. %s 님은 어떠: Even a spirit like me can tell that people will either love it or hate it. What do you think, %s?
Hmm... I'd eat it if it were there, but I wouldn't go looking for it.
strings.(이오가 전혀 모르겠다는 표정으로 빙수와 나린을 번갈아 바라본다.): (Utterly puzzled, Io looks back and forth between the shaved ice and Narin.)
Lord Atkina might surprise us and like it.
strings.그, 글쎄요. 후우, 일단 가볼까요?: W-who knows? Well, shall we go?
strings.(드래곤 아드키나가 손, 아니 앞발로 조용히 배를 쓰다듬는다.): (The dragon Atkina quietly rubs his belly with a hand—or rather, a forepaw.)
strings.이상하게 수레바퀴 안에 있으면 속이 허전하군. 아, 이오인가?: Strange. I feel empty whenever I'm inside the wheel. Ah, Io?
strings.비어있는 수레바퀴가 신경쓰여서 다시 오게 됐네. 오, 그대도 왔군. 며칠: The empty wheel worried me, so I returned. Oh, you've come too. It's only been a few days, but I'm pleased to see you again.
Hello, Lord Atkina. I'm glad to see you too.
Ah, and you are... a spirit. No, a spirit king.
I have only seen you from afar, so my greeting is overdue, Lord Atkina. I am Narin.
strings.물과 얼음의 정령왕이라 들었네, 그동안 이오를 지켜줘서 고맙네. 앞으로도: I've heard you are the Spirit King of Water and Ice. Thank you for watching over Io. Please continue to look after her.
Io has her peculiarities. I can only thank you for being so considerate of her.
strings.얘가 별 이야기를 다 해요. 아드키나 님, 많이 배고프신 것 같아 별미를: Listen to her talk. Lord Atkina, you seemed very hungry, so I brought you a special treat.
A special treat? I look forward to it.
strings.(아드키나가 이오가 준비한 민트 초코 고드름 빙수를 보자 잠시 할 말을: (Atkina falls silent for a moment at the sight of Io's Mint Chocolate Icicle Shaved Ice.)
strings.이오, 준비해준 성의는 고맙다만…. 그래, 성의를 무시하면 안되니 한 입: Io, I appreciate the effort... Yes, I mustn't disregard your kindness. I'll have a bite...
strings.(아드키나가 고개를 들어 수레바퀴의 허공을 향해 포효를 내뿜는다.): (Atkina throws back his head and roars into the empty space inside the wheel.)
strings.하마터면 험한 말을 할 뻔 했군. 이오, 다음에 올 땐 발드릭에게 준 것: I almost said something dreadful. Io, next time, bring me meat, like you did for Valdrick...
Io, Lord Atkina seems rather upset.
...I've never seen him react so strongly.
strings.미안하네. 그대가 이렇게 준비했는데 이 늙은이가 음식 투정을 했지? 이: I'm sorry. You went to all this trouble, and this old fool complained about the food. I didn't expect to remain in this form for so long.
strings.이해해요. 저도 요즘 이상해요. 오랫동안 하던 일이 사라져서 그런지 심심: I understand. I've been feeling strange lately too. With all my old duties gone, I'm bored.
strings.이오, 혹시 샤이닉 같이 심심해 죽을 정도인겐가?: Io, do you mean bored to death, like Shynic?
I don't know. I feel like an empty icebox. As though I might melt away at any moment...
strings.이오, 내가 그 속을 채워줘도 되겠느냐?: Io, may I fill that emptiness for you?
strings.내가 네 속을 모를까. 붙잡고 물을 잔뜩 먹일 거면서. 친구 물 먹이는게: As if I don't know what you're thinking. You'll hold me down and make me drink loads of water. Do you enjoy drowning your friend that much?
strings.(나린이 이오의 반응에 피식 웃다가 아드키나의 허리쪽에서 뭔가를 발견한다: (Narin chuckles at Io's reaction, then notices something near Atkina's waist.)
strings.어, 아드키나 님. 비늘이 떨어진 자리가 있는데, 괜찮으시온지요? 혹시: Oh, Lord Atkina. Some of your scales are missing. Are you well? You are not ill, are you...?
strings.내가 수레바퀴 안에서 힘을 쓰다가 몇 개가 떨어진 모양일세. 메아리의 샘: A few must have come loose while I used my power inside the wheel. They seem to have flown toward Echo Spring.
strings.마침 잘 됐네. 이오, 자네가 찾아주지 않겠나? 보물찾기…라고 생각하면…: Perfect timing. Io, would you find them for me? Think of it as a treasure hunt...
strings.(이오가 문득 생각에 잠기다가 %s의 손을 붙잡는다.): (Io pauses in thought, then takes %s's hand.)
strings.아드키나 님, 다녀올게요. %s, 같이 가자. 왠지 네가 있으면 금방 찾: We'll be back, Lord Atkina. Come with me, %s. I feel we'll find them quickly with you there.
strings.(그때, %s의 머릿속으로 드래곤 아드키나의 목소리가 흘러들어온다.): (At that moment, the dragon Atkina's voice flows into %s's mind.)
strings.그러면… 이오, 같이 갈까요?: Then... shall we go together, Io?
While you visit Echo Spring, Narin can keep me company.
strings.저로 괜찮으시겠사옵니까?: Would my company be agreeable to you?
Of course. Any conversation is a pleasure between those about to become friends.
strings.그러면 아드키나 님, 우리 나린 잘 부탁드려요. 자, 보물을 찾으러 샘으: Then please look after our Narin, Lord Atkina. Now, to the spring for treasure!
strings.(이오가 %s의 손을 붙잡고 수레바퀴 밖을 빠져나가자 고개를 돌려 나린을: (As Io takes %s's hand and leaves the wheel, Atkina turns toward Narin.)
Ah, Narin. Lady Gaia left a message for you.
strings.네? 여신님께서 말이옵니까? 어떤 말씀을 남기셨습니까?: What? The goddess herself? What did she say?
strings.불타 사라질 뻔했던 대륙의 일부였던 데보라를 얼리고, 많은 생명을 살린: She said she was glad you were there to freeze Deborah, part of a continent nearly consumed by fire, and save so many lives... And...
strings.(메아리의 샘을 헤매던 이오와 %s의 시야에 얼음과 눈 사이에서 반짝반짝: (While searching Echo Spring, Io and %s spot something sparkling blue among the ice and snow.)
strings.확실히 아드키나 님의 비늘이야. 오래 찾아야될 줄 알았는데, 일찍 찾아서: Those are definitely Lord Atkina's scales. I thought we'd be searching for ages. I'm glad it was quick.
Lord Atkina sent me here on purpose.
When was it? Long ago. Very long ago, though not quite beyond memory...
strings.부모님이랑 설원에서 놀던 적이 있었어. 별건 아니지만, 이렇게 작은 물건: I used to play in the snowfield with my parents. Nothing grand. They would hide little things like these for me to find.
strings.마치 보물을 찾는 것처럼 말이야. 그런 걸 찾느라 꽤 늦게 들어가는 적도: Like a treasure hunt. Sometimes I stayed out quite late looking. But my parents never scolded me...
strings.이오니스, 너는 무엇이든지 끈기있게 찾아내는 아이야. 나중에 어려운 일이: 'Ionis, you're a child who keeps searching until you find anything. If you face difficulties someday, never give up. Keep going, just as you do now.' That's what they said...
strings.하긴, 아드키나 님 정도면 우리 부모님과도 인연이 있었을 거야. 보물찾기: I suppose someone like Lord Atkina would have known my parents. He must have sent me on this treasure hunt deliberately. Hehe...
It was fun. I wasn't bored.
Wonderful. Hehe. Like I've been out for a pleasant stroll.
strings.%s 네 존재 자체가 우리에겐 선물이야. 후후…. 나만 그렇게 생각하는: Your very presence is a gift to us, %s. Hehe... I'm not the only one who thinks so.
You're giving me too much credit.
strings.후후, 어떻게 받아들이든 괜찮아. 그리고 나도 이제 조금은 여유있게 살아: Hehe. Take it however you like. Perhaps I can afford to live a little more leisurely now?
strings.물론 해야 할 일을 할 거야. 눈 앞에 얼음이 녹는다고 바로 따뜻해지진: Of course, I'll still do what needs doing. The world doesn't turn warm just because the ice in front of you melts.
Let's go. Lord Atkina must be waiting.
strings.아드키나 님, 다녀왔어요! 나린도 오래 기다렸지?: We're back, Lord Atkina! Did you wait long, Narin?
Lord Atkina and I enjoyed a pleasant conversation.
strings.혹시 귀여움과 아름다움을 구분할 수 있는 안목에 대한 것인가요? 벨레드가: Was it about having an eye for the difference between cuteness and beauty? What Veled mentioned...
strings.비슷하긴 하지만, 조금 다르네. 고대신과 정령…, 그 시기의 생명에 대한: Similar, but a little different. We spoke of the ancient gods, the spirits, and life in those times.
It was fascinating, Lord Atkina. I am glad you enjoyed my stories as well.
strings.나린, 넌 무슨 이야기를 했어?: Narin, what stories did you tell?
strings.나는 네가 어릴 때의 이야기를 했단다. 그때는 얼마나 지금같지 않고 귀여: Stories of your childhood. How adorable you were, so unlike now... There was a boy you liked, wasn't there?
Just wait until we get back to the village. I'll give you plenty of affection. Hehe.
Oh, we found the treasure—I mean, the scales.
I'm glad you found them so quickly. No need to give them back to me.
strings.사람들 사이에서 드래곤의 비늘이 행운과 건강을 안겨다 준다는 이야기를 들: I've heard humans say that dragon scales bring good luck and health. They are my gift to you, Io.
Thank you, Lord Atkina! They're beautiful.
When the opportunity arises, I'll prepare gifts for %s and Narin as well.
Your very presence is a gift, Lord Atkina.
Thank you for saying so. It is all thanks to Lady Gaia's grace...
strings.가이아 님의 은혜가 아니었다면 나는 글루아트와 같은 악한 존재가 됐었을지: Without her grace, I might have become an evil being like Gluart.
strings.(이리스가 아니었다면 다른 모습이 됐을지도 모르는 나처럼….): (Like how I might have become someone else without Iris...)
strings.글루아트에게 어떤 사연이 있는지 당시의 나는 관심조차 두지 않았어. 그가: At the time, I never cared what story lay behind Gluart. Only later did I learn that he had lured many humans to their deaths with his scales.
That was my failing... In the end, I had looked away...
Before going to slay him, Ziskad came to question me.
strings.여신을 따르는 내가 글루아트와는 다르다는 걸 확인하고 싶었다더군. 같은: He wanted to be certain that I, a follower of the goddess, was different from Gluart. Fortunately, we agreed. Otherwise, one of us would no longer be here.
strings.지스카드를 비롯해 초인이 된 아이들은 언젠가부터 자신이 보통 인간과 다른: Ziskad and the others who became Champions must have grown uneasy about becoming something other than ordinary humans. They must have spent so long alone...
strings.마치 나처럼 말이네…. 그래도 다행이지. 적이 아닌 친구로 함께 할 수: Like me... Still, we are fortunate. We can stand together as friends, rather than enemies.
strings.이런 믿음을 가지게 된 것은 모두 자네 덕분이네. 모두를 하나로 이끌어줬: It is thanks to you that we came to trust in this. You brought us all together.
Oh, no. I hardly did anything.
Too much modesty will get an icicle through your heart. Accept what you've done.
Hehe. Many people have changed because of you, %s.
Yes. You are already a treasure to us all.
strings.(아드키나의 말에 이오와 나린이 환하게 웃는다.): (Io and Narin smile brightly at Atkina's words.)
strings.그런 걸 가지고 부끄럽긴. 아드키나 님, 저희랑 좀 더 시간 보내시지 않: No need to be embarrassed. Lord Atkina, would you like to spend a little more time with us?
strings.좋지. 그러면 계속 이야기를 하는 건 어떤가?: Gladly. Shall we continue our conversation?
strings.이야기도 좋지만, 이건 어떠신지요?: Conversation is pleasant, but how about this?
(Narin opens the scroll she is carrying, and all sorts of objects fall from it.)
Cards, dice, even a game board...
strings.다 같이 여흥을 즐기시죠. 이거라면 해가 지는지도 모르고 놀 수 있사옵니: Let us enjoy ourselves together. With these, we can play until the sun sets without even noticing!
strings.저기 내가 룰을 모르는 노인이지만, 끼어도 되겠나?: May an old fellow who doesn't know the rules join in?
Of course. These games are more fun when everyone plays together.
strings.(이오가 눈보라를 일으켜 아드키나의 앞발에 카드를 끼워넣는다. 이어 나린: (Io raises a flurry of snow to tuck cards into Atkina's forepaw. Narin deals the remaining cards, explains the rules, and the game begins.)
strings.(그렇게 불타는 수레바퀴 안은 게임을 즐기는 이들의 웃음소리로 가득 채워: (Before long, the Burning Wheel fills with the laughter of those enjoying the game. Though one person may feel differently.)
